limits.notes: Read directly, but the page's 'Preparing your manuscript' section comes after a long table of open-access institutions, past the point where the fetch tool truncates the page. Only the scope, policy and charges parts were read; see 'unverified' for the rest. 'The inclusion of a data availability statement is a requirement for papers published in the Journal', and authors must 'publicly release all data and software code underlying any published paper as a condition of publication'. The submission site (https://g3.msubmit.net/cgi-bin/main.plex?form_type=display_auth_instructions) says 'Initial manuscripts may be in any format' but 'must include line and page numbers for review', uploaded 'as a single PDF (<15MB) or as separate files'. Files are reformatted to G3 style at revision. 2026-11-16 (browser): the page now has a 'Preparing your manuscript' section: abstract 'limited to 250 words for Investigations'; 'Please provide a 100 word summary' (Article summary); a running title of 50 characters or less; keywords (no number).
